{{Quote|Now watch closely, everyone. I'm going to show you how to eat a meatlump. A meatlump of meat and lumpiness. The trick is not to fear it. Or to chew.|Meatlump King|<ref name="SWG:TMK" />}}

The '''meatlump''' was the favorite [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] of the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump gang]], which was named after it.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref>

==Description==
{{Quote|Once, not long ago, I dropped my meatlump into a river. When I tried to get it back, I fell in. I thought I'd drown, but the water carried me to the shore. From then on, I always ate my snacks away from water.|Meatlump King|<ref name="SWG:TMK" />}}
While it was considered a great-tasting food, it had an ingredient list that would cause most people to lose their lunch if they knew.<ref name="CDHZ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meatlumps appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. Meatlump was actually two distinct items in Star Wars Galaxies. The first Meatlump was a chef-created food item. Its appearance was that of [[Sausage/Legends|sausage]]. Like a few other foods and drinks, the schematic for Meatlump was removed after Publish 6. The original Meatlump remained distinct in game with its original appearance intact. It was described as a processed and compressed meat hunk. It also was used in space station food stores.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Meatlump}}</ref>
